# Documentation assets

NeonD's Curious logo is a project-created SVG design, committed with the original
local documentation in 63739cb. The light, dark and favicon variants live in
website/static/img and use inline vector paths, with no external image assets.
They are distributed under the repository's Apache-2.0 license. No trademark
license beyond the applicable source license is implied.

The theme requests Inter when installed locally and otherwise uses system fonts;
it does not download Inter. Fonts, icons and styles emitted by JavaScript/CSS
packages are covered by the browser dependency inventory and their license files.
Retain the generated third-party directory and JavaScript LICENSE comments when
hosting or redistributing the built site.
